item.title: Modeless Keyboard Layout Switching in GNOME with Shyriiwook
item.description: Recently, I treated myself with a few extra keys on my mechanical keyboard (just flexin' here), and I decided to set them up to switch keyboard layouts modelessly. Little did I know that trying to make this seemingly simple feature work in GNOME would turn into a ridiculously tough challenge. That’s how my pet project, Shyriiwook (also on GitHub as madhead/shyriiwook), came to life.
